en: Improved `/resume` and `claude --resume` on a session that is running in the background: they now open that session instead of refusing, and a prompt given with `claude --resume <id> "prompt"` is sent to it as its next turn
zh: 改进在后台运行的 session 上使用 `/resume` 和 `claude --resume`：现在会打开该 session 而不是拒绝，并且通过 `claude --resume <id> "prompt"` 提供的 prompt 会作为其下一轮发送给它
